name: Nobu Matsuhisa
bio: Japanese chef who worked in Peru and Argentina before Los Angeles. He cooked Japanese fish with Peruvian chilli and citrus and opened Matsuhisa in 1987 and Nobu in New York in 1994.

milestones.event: Opened the restaurant Matsuhisa in Los Angeles.
Opened the first Nobu in New York with Robert De Niro and partners.
